//: Matched on word boundaries with an open suffix: 'optic' catches 'optics', but 'led' never matches 'called'. An item is kept if it hits one 'strong' term or two 'weak' ones. Manufacturer names are 'strong' because trade-press headlines often name only the company.
//topics: Substring rules that assign topic tags when the AI summariser is unavailable.
